13 · Selection Pressure (πN - πS)

  • Show All Code
  • Hide All Code
  • View Source

Per-gene selection pressure bar plots with FDR significance

genomics
virology
selection
piN-piS
evolution

Computes per-gene mean Δ(πN−πS) pooled across all DPI timepoints, maps bar colour to limma FDR via viridis, overlays significance stars (∗∗∗ / ∗∗ / ∗), produces a stacked DPI panel comparing dpi3 vs dpi5, and exports publication-ready PNG + SVG figures.

Overview

Item Details
Input delta_per_sample.csv · selection_gene_key.csv (in data/)
Key packages pandas, numpy, matplotlib, scipy
Statistics Mean ± SEM · Limma BH FDR · Kruskal–Wallis BH FDR
Output selection_pressure_bar.png/.svg · selection_pressure_stacked_dpi.png/.svg
Download template.qmd

Edit GENE_ORDER if your pathogen uses a different gene / protein name ordering. The default palette maps FDR ≥ 0.05 bars to grey; significant bars use the viridis colormap scaled from the minimum observed FDR to 0.05.

← Gallery Download .qmd

User Configuration

Code 
GENE_ORDER = ["nsp1", "nsp2", "nsp3", "nsp4", "capsid", "E3", "E2", "6K", "E1"]

FDR_COLUMN       = "limma_overall_bh_fdr"   # or "kruskal_bh_fdr"
FDR_ALPHA        = 0.05                      # significance threshold for colour/star
FDR_STAR_THRESH  = [0.001, 0.01, 0.05]       # *** / ** / *
DPI_PANEL_LABELS = ["dpi3", "dpi5"]

OUTPUT_DIR = "outputs"
DPI_EXPORT = 300

Panel 1 — Mean Δ(πN−πS) per Gene (Pooled)

Code 
summary_rows = []
for gene in GENE_ORDER:
    mask  = delta_df["product"] == gene
    vals  = delta_df.loc[mask, "delta_piN_minus_piS"]
    summary_rows.append({
        "gene":       gene,
        "mean_delta": vals.mean(),
        "sem":        vals.sem(),
        "n":          len(vals),
    })

pooled_df = pd.DataFrame(summary_rows)
pooled_df = pooled_df.merge(
    gene_key[["product", FDR_COLUMN]].rename(columns={"product": "gene"}),
    on="gene", how="left"
)

# Cap FDR at 0.99 for visualisation; clamp negative / NaN to 0.001
pooled_df[FDR_COLUMN] = pooled_df[FDR_COLUMN].clip(lower=0.0, upper=0.99).fillna(0.99)
pooled_df
gene mean_delta sem n limma_overall_bh_fdr

1 nsp2 0.003203 0.000201 9 0.527011
2 nsp3 0.011778 0.002079 9 0.094839
3 nsp4 0.001131 0.000090 9 0.797523
4 capsid 0.001971 0.000155 9 0.674204
5 E3 0.015878 0.002023 9 0.041767
6 E2 0.016176 0.002365 9 0.039354
7 6K 0.013809 0.001072 9 0.063178
8 E1 0.005799 0.000422 9 0.313528
Code 
# ── Colour mapping: viridis for sig, grey for non-sig ─────────────────────
cmap     = plt.cm.viridis
fdr_vals = pooled_df.loc[pooled_df[FDR_COLUMN] < FDR_ALPHA, FDR_COLUMN]
vmin     = fdr_vals.min() if len(fdr_vals) > 0 else 0.001
vmax     = FDR_ALPHA

def bar_color(fdr):
    if fdr < FDR_ALPHA:
        return cmap((fdr - vmin) / (vmax - vmin))
    return "#aaaaaa"

def star_label(fdr):
    if fdr < 0.001:
        return "***"
    if fdr < 0.01:
        return "**"
    if fdr < 0.05:
        return "*"
    return ""

colors = [bar_color(f) for f in pooled_df[FDR_COLUMN]]
stars  = [star_label(f) for f in pooled_df[FDR_COLUMN]]

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 4))
x       = np.arange(len(pooled_df))

bars = ax.bar(x, pooled_df["mean_delta"], yerr=pooled_df["sem"],
              color=colors, edgecolor="black", linewidth=0.5,
              capsize=3, error_kw={"linewidth": 0.8})

# ── Significance stars ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
for xi, (val, sem_val, star) in enumerate(zip(
    pooled_df["mean_delta"], pooled_df["sem"], stars
)):
    if star:
        sign = 1 if val >= 0 else -1
        offset = sem_val + np.ptp(pooled_df["mean_delta"]) * 0.04
        ax.text(xi, val + sign * offset, star, ha="center", va="center",
                fontsize=10, fontweight="bold")

# ── Decor ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ax.axhline(0, color="black", linewidth=0.8)
ax.set_xticks(x)
ax.set_xticklabels(pooled_df["gene"], rotation=30, ha="right")
ax.set_ylabel("Δ(πN − πS)")
ax.set_title("Selection Pressure per Gene (pooled DPIs)", fontweight="bold")

# ── Colour bar ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
sm = plt.cm.ScalarMappable(cmap=cmap, norm=plt.Normalize(vmin=vmin, vmax=vmax))
sm.set_array([])
cbar = fig.colorbar(sm, ax=ax, shrink=0.65, aspect=20, pad=0.02)
cbar.set_label("limma BH FDR", fontsize=7)
cbar.ax.tick_params(labelsize=6)

fig.tight_layout()

png_path = os.path.join(OUTPUT_DIR, "selection_pressure_bar.png")
svg_path = os.path.join(OUTPUT_DIR, "selection_pressure_bar.svg")
fig.savefig(png_path, dpi=DPI_EXPORT, bbox_inches="tight")
fig.savefig(svg_path, format="svg", bbox_inches="tight")
plt.show()

print(f"Saved: {png_path}")
print(f"Saved: {svg_path}")

Panel 2 — Stacked DPI Subplots (dpi3 · dpi5)

Code 
dpi_df = delta_df[delta_df["dpi"].isin(DPI_PANEL_LABELS)].copy()

dpi_summary = []
for dpi in DPI_PANEL_LABELS:
    for gene in GENE_ORDER:
        mask = (dpi_df["dpi"] == dpi) & (dpi_df["product"] == gene)
        vals = dpi_df.loc[mask, "delta_piN_minus_piS"]
        if len(vals) > 0:
            dpi_summary.append({
                "dpi":        dpi,
                "gene":       gene,
                "mean_delta": vals.mean(),
                "sem":        vals.sem(),
                "n":          len(vals),
            })

dpi_pooled = pd.DataFrame(dpi_summary)
dpi_pooled = dpi_pooled.merge(
    gene_key[["product", FDR_COLUMN]].rename(columns={"product": "gene"}),
    on="gene", how="left"
)
dpi_pooled[FDR_COLUMN] = dpi_pooled[FDR_COLUMN].clip(lower=0.0, upper=0.99).fillna(0.99)
dpi_pooled.head()
dpi gene mean_delta sem n limma_overall_bh_fdr
0 dpi3 nsp1 0.000792 0.000264 3 0.835215
1 dpi3 nsp2 0.002680 0.000183 3 0.527011
2 dpi3 nsp3 0.019043 0.002635 3 0.094839
3 dpi3 nsp4 0.001184 0.000185 3 0.797523

Code 
n_dpis  = len(DPI_PANEL_LABELS)
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, n_dpis, figsize=(10, 4.5), sharey=True)

for ax, dpi_label in zip(axes, DPI_PANEL_LABELS):
    sub = dpi_pooled[dpi_pooled["dpi"] == dpi_label].copy()
    sub = sub.set_index("gene").reindex(GENE_ORDER).reset_index()
    sub[FDR_COLUMN] = sub[FDR_COLUMN].fillna(0.99)

    # Recompute colours for this subplot's FDR range
    sub_fdr_vals = sub.loc[sub[FDR_COLUMN] < FDR_ALPHA, FDR_COLUMN]
    sub_vmin     = sub_fdr_vals.min() if len(sub_fdr_vals) > 0 else 0.001

    def _sub_bar_color(fdr):
        if fdr < FDR_ALPHA:
            return cmap((fdr - sub_vmin) / (vmax - sub_vmin))
        return "#aaaaaa"

    sub_colors = [_sub_bar_color(f) for f in sub[FDR_COLUMN]]
    sub_stars  = [star_label(f) for f in sub[FDR_COLUMN]]

    x = np.arange(len(sub))
    ax.bar(x, sub["mean_delta"], yerr=sub["sem"],
           color=sub_colors, edgecolor="black", linewidth=0.5,
           capsize=3, error_kw={"linewidth": 0.8})

    for xi, (val, sem_val, star) in enumerate(zip(
        sub["mean_delta"], sub["sem"], sub_stars
    )):
        if star:
            sign   = 1 if val >= 0 else -1
            offset = sem_val + np.ptp(pooled_df["mean_delta"]) * 0.05
            ax.text(xi, val + sign * offset, star, ha="center", va="center",
                    fontsize=10, fontweight="bold")

    ax.axhline(0, color="black", linewidth=0.8)
    ax.set_xticks(x)
    ax.set_xticklabels(sub["gene"].fillna(""), rotation=30, ha="right")
    ax.set_title(dpi_label.upper(), fontweight="bold")
    ax.set_ylabel("Δ(πN − πS)")

fig.tight_layout()

png_path = os.path.join(OUTPUT_DIR, "selection_pressure_stacked_dpi.png")
svg_path = os.path.join(OUTPUT_DIR, "selection_pressure_stacked_dpi.svg")
fig.savefig(png_path, dpi=DPI_EXPORT, bbox_inches="tight")
fig.savefig(svg_path, format="svg", bbox_inches="tight")
plt.show()

print(f"Saved: {png_path}")
print(f"Saved: {svg_path}")

```{python}
    sub[FDR_COLUMN] = sub[FDR_COLUMN].fillna(0.99)

    # Recompute colours for this subplot's FDR range
    sub_fdr_vals = sub.loc[sub[FDR_COLUMN] < FDR_ALPHA, FDR_COLUMN]
    sub_vmin     = sub_fdr_vals.min() if len(sub_fdr_vals) > 0 else 0.001

    def _sub_bar_color(fdr):
        if fdr < FDR_ALPHA:
            return cmap((fdr - sub_vmin) / (vmax - sub_vmin))
        return "#aaaaaa"

    sub_colors = [_sub_bar_color(f) for f in sub[FDR_COLUMN]]
    sub_stars  = [star_label(f) for f in sub[FDR_COLUMN]]

    x = np.arange(len(sub))
    ax.bar(x, sub["mean_delta"], yerr=sub["sem"],
           color=sub_colors, edgecolor="black", linewidth=0.5,
           capsize=3, error_kw={"linewidth": 0.8})

    for xi, (val, sem_val, star) in enumerate(zip(
        sub["mean_delta"], sub["sem"], sub_stars
    )):
        if star:
            sign   = 1 if val >= 0 else -1
            offset = sem_val + np.ptp(pooled_df["mean_delta"]) * 0.05
            ax.text(xi, val + sign * offset, star, ha="center", va="center",
                    fontsize=10, fontweight="bold")

    ax.axhline(0, color="black", linewidth=0.8)
    ax.set_xticks(x)
    ax.set_xticklabels(sub["gene"].fillna(""), rotation=30, ha="right")
    ax.set_title(dpi_label.upper(), fontweight="bold")
    ax.set_ylabel("Δ(πN − πS)")

fig.tight_layout()

png_path = os.path.join(OUTPUT_DIR, "selection_pressure_stacked_dpi.png")
svg_path = os.path.join(OUTPUT_DIR, "selection_pressure_stacked_dpi.svg")
fig.savefig(png_path, dpi=DPI_EXPORT, bbox_inches="tight")
fig.savefig(svg_path, format="svg", bbox_inches="tight")
plt.show()

print(f"Saved: {png_path}")
print(f"Saved: {svg_path}")
```

## Summary Table

```{python}
#| label: summary-table

summary_out = pooled_df[["gene", "mean_delta", "sem", FDR_COLUMN]].copy()
summary_out = summary_out.rename(columns={FDR_COLUMN: "limma_bh_fdr"})
summary_out["significance"] = [star_label(f) for f in summary_out["limma_bh_fdr"]]
summary_out = summary_out.round(6)

csv_path = os.path.join(OUTPUT_DIR, "selection_pressure_summary.csv")
summary_out.to_csv(csv_path, index=False)
print(f"Saved: {csv_path}")
summary_out
```
